result.title: Minimum-Cost Robust Evidence Certificates for Horn Reasoning under Correlated Source Failures
result.summary: A small justification for a rule-based conclusion may disappear when a source is withdrawn, and multiple derivations need not provide independent evidence. We study minimum-cost certificates that preserve a Horn conclusion under every withdrawal of at most k source domains. Evidence records remain distinct from asserted facts, supporting replicated attestations and overlapping failure dependencies. Transversals of minimal-support footprints characterize robustness and explain why disjoint-proof requirements can reject valid certificates. An exact procedure alternates weighted evidence selection with a source-failure oracle. A rule-closed counterinterpretation yields a globally valid selection cut without enumerating supports or failure scenarios. We prove correctness, finite termination, and cost optimality, establish coNP-completeness of unrestricted verification and NP-completeness of synthesis for every fixed budget, and identify a tractable reachability restriction. Experiments on controlled benchmarks, reachability graphs, and ontology-derived instances demonstrate that our counterinterpretation-guided synthesis achieves up to 92% optimum coverage within practical resource bounds, outperforming scenario expansion and general abduction while confirming the necessity of transversal-based reasoning over proof-packing heuristics.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究在至多 k 个来源域被撤回时仍能保持 Horn 结论的最小代价证据证书，用最小支撑集的横截刻画鲁棒性，指出「不相交证明」要求会误拒有效证书，并给出交替加权证据选择与来源失效 oracle 的精确算法及复杂度结论。
AI.relevance_reason: 「多个推导不构成独立证据」及按失效相关性构造稳健证据集的思路，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、多 latent 假设的独立性与贡献分配提供待核查的概念线索，其反解释割生成算法也可供参考。
